correctness.rationale: Vandermonde quadratics give the unique structure constants; the multiplication on the intrinsic square is exactly W. Its idempotent equation excludes nonzero solutions and W²=W. Distinct nonproportional square lines force monomial natural-basis changes via two bilinear forms with three distinct generalized eigenvalues. The unique square-zero line computes Aut(W) as translations; coordinate comparison gives exactly translations of unordered slope triples and forces each ambient automorphism to be the identity. Centering and cubic discriminant give the classifying open plane. Exact rational tests passed, but are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 survey specifically identifies the structure of the idempotent-free non-solvable 3D locus and the expected two essential parameters as an open problem. The result identifies a natural, intrinsic full stratum, proves no nonzero idempotents and nonsolvability simultaneously, calculates a complete two-polynomial discriminant classifier, and proves rigidity of each algebra. The excluded boundary is mathematically meaningful, not an arbitrary slice.
